source_datasets.name: CBS StatLine 83288NED: Religieuze betrokkenheid; kerkelijke gezindte; regio; 2010-2015
source_datasets.notes: Final annual Labour Force Survey percentages for people aged 15+. The table states that sample uncertainty exists but publishes no standard errors or confidence intervals. Values are rounded to whole percentages.

source_datasets.name: PDOK Bestuurlijke Gebieden, current provinciegebied
source_datasets.notes: Current 2026 province areas derived from the Basisregistratie Kadaster.

indicators.label: Weekly-or-more attendance %
indicators.description: Share of the total population aged 15+ who report attending a religious or worldview gathering once a week or more.
indicators.quality_notes: CBS Labour Force Survey estimate for the total population aged 15+; the source publishes rounded whole percentages and no population count or machine-readable uncertainty interval in table 83288NED.

indicators.label: Seldom-or-never attendance %
indicators.description: Share of the total population aged 15+ who report seldom or never attending a religious or worldview gathering.
indicators.quality_notes: CBS Labour Force Survey estimate for the total population aged 15+; the source publishes rounded whole percentages and no population count or machine-readable uncertainty interval in table 83288NED.
